description: The Hello, circuit demo page: SVG circuit, readouts panel, voltage slider and explanation panel.
name: HelloCircuitPage

description: The project landing page with the Demos list.
name: LandingPage

description: Deterministic absolute value by clearing the sign bit.
name: abs

description: Deterministic arccosine on the closed unit interval; NaN outside.
name: acos

description: Full circuit analysis: rejects invalid values, solves, blows the most overloaded bulb and re-solves until none is over its limit, then lists blown bulbs last.
name: analyze

description: Deterministic arcsine on the closed unit interval; NaN outside.
name: asin

description: Builds the MNA system A x = rhs from every component stamp: conductances, Norton current sources and ideal voltage sources.
name: assemble

description: Deterministic arctangent within 4 ulp via reciprocal and half-angle reductions.
name: atan

description: Quadrant-aware arctangent of y over x with IEEE signed-zero behaviour.
name: atan2

description: Range reduction for atan: reciprocal flip above 1 then two half-angle shrinks.
name: atan_reduce

description: Solves U x = y in place from the bottom row up.
name: back_substitute

description: Yields a BulbBlown issue for each blown bulb, in component order.
name: blown_bulb_issues

description: Box-Muller transform: two uniforms become two independent standard normals, cosine output first.
name: box_muller

description: Turns solved unknowns into node voltages, voltage across, currents including wires via KCL, powers and bulb brightness.
name: build_solution

description: Shared right-hand-side length check returning DimensionMismatch.
name: check_rhs_len

description: Partial pivot search: largest magnitude in column k at or below row k.
name: choose_pivot

description: Places an ideal battery between two nodes and returns its component id.
name: circuit_add_battery

description: Places a bulb rated at given volts and watts and returns its component id.
name: circuit_add_bulb

description: Places a resistor between two nodes and returns its component id.
name: circuit_add_resistor

description: Places an open or closed switch and returns its component id.
name: circuit_add_switch

description: Places an ideal wire between two nodes and returns its component id.
name: circuit_add_wire

description: Reads one bulb brightness from the last solve, NaN with a message on failure.
name: circuit_bulb_brightness

description: Frees a circuit; a dead or unknown handle is ERR_HANDLE, never undefined behaviour.
name: circuit_free

description: Reports whether the last solve produced a solution.
name: circuit_has_solution

description: Kind code of issue i, from 1 invalid value to 6 blown bulb.
name: circuit_issue_kind

description: Writes issue i plain-language explanation to the shared output string.
name: circuit_issue_message

description: Component or node id that issue i points at.
name: circuit_issue_part

description: Creates an empty circuit in the handle table and returns its non-zero handle.
name: circuit_new

description: Adds a junction to a circuit and returns its node id.
name: circuit_node

description: Screws a fresh bulb in place of a blown one; non-bulbs are ERR_KIND.
name: circuit_replace_bulb

description: Number of f64 values in the results buffer.
name: circuit_results_len

description: Address of the last solve results, four f64 per component.
name: circuit_results_ptr

description: Sets a component main value such as battery EMF, applied at the next solve.
name: circuit_set_value

description: Solves the circuit, refreshes the shared results buffer and returns the issue count.
name: circuit_solve

description: Flips a switch and returns its new state; non-switches are ERR_KIND.
name: circuit_toggle

description: Keeps a ranged float draw half-open below hi using float next_down, for any sign of hi.
name: clamp_below

description: Current through one component from the voltage across it, per stamp; an ideal battery's MNA unknown is negated to read out of plus.
name: component_current

description: Returns x with the sign bit of sign, exactly.
name: copysign

description: Deterministic cosine via sin_cos.
name: cos

description: Writes the readouts view onto the SVG circuit and the control panel.
name: draw

description: One Gaussian elimination step storing L multipliers in place.
name: eliminate_below

description: Deterministic e^x within 2 ulp via ln2 range reduction and a Taylor kernel.
name: exp

description: Horner-evaluated Taylor series for e^r on the reduced interval.
name: exp_taylor

description: Plain-language title and body explaining why the bulb looks the way it does.
name: explanation

description: Records the last error message and returns the given status code.
name: fail

description: Reports one FloatingNode per connected island that has components but no battery or ground, naming its lowest node.
name: floating_islands

description: Rounds toward negative infinity exactly.
name: floor

description: Formats a reading with its unit, or an em dash when there is none.
name: formatReading

description: Solves L y = P b with the implied unit diagonal.
name: forward_substitute

description: Writes the URL hash for a demo state; empty for the default state.
name: hashFromState

description: Adds an empty circuit slot to the handle table and returns its handle.
name: insert_empty

description: Lists an InvalidValue issue for each component with a non-physical value, in order.
name: invalid_components

description: Safety net naming the node or battery behind an unexpected singular pivot in the MNA solve.
name: issue_for_pivot

description: Maps a CircuitIssue to the numeric kind code the JS loader names in IssueKind.
name: issue_kind_code

description: The component or node index a CircuitIssue points at.
name: issue_part_index

description: fdlibm cosine polynomial on the reduced interval.
name: kernel_cos

description: fdlibm sine polynomial on the reduced interval.
name: kernel_sin

description: Returns a copy of the last error message for native callers and tests.
name: last_error

description: Deterministic natural log within 2 ulp via mantissa split and the atanh series.
name: ln

description: Fetches and instantiates the circuits WASM bridge and returns the Circuit class wrapping its exports.
name: loadCircuits

description: One-call dense solve of A x = b by LU with partial pivoting.
name: lu_solve

description: Loads the engine, builds the hello circuit from the URL-hash state and wires the page controls.
name: main

description: Largest absolute matrix entry; scales the singular-pivot tolerance.
name: max_abs_entry

description: Picks the intact bulb with the highest power to rated-power ratio above BLOW_RATIO; ties go to the lowest id.
name: most_overloaded

description: Converts a nanosecond count held as f64 into Seconds; shared by FixedClock step and elapsed.
name: nanos_to_seconds

description: Largest float strictly below x; portable replacement for f64 next_down under MSRV 1.80.
name: next_down

description: Net current into each node from non-wire components, plus the wire adjacency used to spread it.
name: node_inflows

description: Horner sum over odd reciprocal denominators, alternating for atan or all-positive for the atanh series in ln.
name: odd_series

description: Reports OpenCircuit for each non-shorted battery with nonzero EMF that delivers no current.
name: open_batteries

description: Stores a string in the shared output buffer and returns its byte length.
name: output

description: Builds the normal f64 power of two 2^k from exponent bits; nested helper of scale_pow2.
name: pow2

description: Power V times I of each component, treating a floating component as zero.
name: powers

description: Derives every on-screen reading and flag from one circuit solve.
name: readouts

description: Cody-Waite reduction of an angle to about plus or minus pi/4 plus a quadrant mod 4.
name: reduce_quadrant

description: Frees the slot behind a handle, leaving it dead forever so handles never alias.
name: remove

description: Rounds to nearest integer, halfway cases away from zero.
name: round

description: 1-ulp correction for sqrt: steps to the lower neighbour when its square is closer.
name: round_down_if_closer

description: Allocates a byte buffer in linear memory for JS to fill.
name: sb_alloc

description: Releases a buffer from sb_alloc of the same length.
name: sb_free

description: Byte length of the last error message.
name: sb_last_error_len

description: Address of the last error message in linear memory.
name: sb_last_error_ptr

description: Byte length of the shared output string.
name: sb_out_len

description: Address of the string the last string-returning export produced.
name: sb_out_ptr

description: Multiplies by 2 to the k, splitting large shifts so the power-of-two factor never overflows.
name: scale_pow2

description: Fills the explanation panel with text nodes so engine messages are never parsed as HTML.
name: showExplanation

description: Deterministic sine via sin_cos.
name: sin

description: Deterministic sine and cosine with one shared range reduction.
name: sin_cos

description: Slerp blend weights with a lerp fallback for nearly identical rotations.
name: slerp_weights

description: Solves the circuit as it stands: topology, pre-solve source checks, floating islands, MNA assembly, LU solve, results and open-circuit batteries.
name: solve_once

description: Finds shorted batteries, fatal for ideal ones and emf over r for real ones, and loops of ideal batteries closed via union-find.
name: source_problems

description: Breadth-first spanning forest of the wire graph rooted at each tree's lowest node; chords of wire loops are left out.
name: spanning_forest

description: Splits a positive normal into exponent and mantissa in the sqrt-half to sqrt-two band.
name: split_mantissa

description: Pure-Rust square root within 1 ulp; handles subnormals, NaN, negatives, zero and infinity.
name: sqrt

description: Newton iterations for sqrt of a positive normal from an exponent-halving first guess.
name: sqrt_newton

description: Adds conductance g between two MNA unknowns, skipping the reference node.
name: stamp_conductance

description: Adds a current source into node a and out of node b on the right-hand side.
name: stamp_current_source

description: Adds an ideal voltage source with unknown current k: plus and minus one incidence entries and the EMF on the right-hand side.
name: stamp_voltage_source

description: Reads the demo switch, bypass and voltage state from a URL hash, clamping volts to the slider.
name: stateFromHash

description: Deterministic tangent as sin over cos.
name: tan

description: Rounds Seconds to whole nanoseconds; negative or NaN becomes 0, huge values saturate at u64 max.
name: to_nanos

description: Marks which nodes have at least one component attached.
name: touched_nodes

description: Rounds toward zero exactly; large and non-finite values pass through.
name: trunc

description: sqrt of 1 minus x squared, factored for precision near plus or minus 1; shared by acos and asin.
name: unit_complement

description: Fills in wire and closed-switch currents from Kirchhoff's current law by walking the spanning forest from leaves to root.
name: wire_currents

description: Runs a closure on the circuit behind a handle or fails with ERR_HANDLE.
name: with_slot
